name: Lucy
source:
A pretty calm girl.
She loves nature, most likely due to the fact that most of her life was lived on a farm. It is unlikely there will be any problems with her.
She looks too balanced in comparison with some of the other recruits...
Maybe sending her to this place was a mistake - she doesn't look like someone who will struggle with mana control.
Perhaps, she can become a good healer.
